5060.body:
The $50,000 top prize on "FIND THE 7S" is no longer available because all eight have been claimed. The biggest prize anyone can win today is $10,000. Use that amount when you decide.

Tomorrow's count on "FIND THE 7S" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
